notes:
PASS on the fake backend (gate exit 0); evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The gate report has no finding and no warning. Model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wB1-019) and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by stays null, native.py was never imported, no hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed. Recon: the card's first entry symbol sartoriuslib.devices.balance:Balance was confirmed at src/sartoriuslib/devices/balance.py:300 (the other entry symbols, SyncBalance and the sinks, were confirmed in the clone as well); the facade is asynchronous, so this is a direct Driver with async methods and a native.py factory. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD'S HELPER HINT: the card's decision is direct-driver, which the package follows; its helper hint PythonObjectDriver is not used because the family command/result grammar cannot convert the facade's dataclass readings, Unit/IntEnum values and milligram output. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD'S CANDIDATE CLASSES: cap.device.configure.v1 is used for the six typed settings, but cap.sensing.read.v1 is not bound because catalog show lists only sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque, while this device is instrument.balance; cap.measure.mass.v1 is the catalogue class that binds instrument.balance. The card's safety.limit_hints (MAX_ACCURACY = 1, MAX_FAST = 6, max_drift_ms = 0.0) are enum constants and a recorder default, not limits of a balance, so no Limit is derived from them. No Limit.operator_required is declared: every writable input is a string whose allowed set is quoted from an upstream enum or the p07 display-unit table, and no numeric device bound is stated. COVERED: net, gross and tare weight in mg; the stability flag; the status state; model, serial and software identity; the six typed parameter-table settings as reads and writes (display unit p07, filter mode p01, auto-zero p06, isoCAL p15, tare behavior p05, menu access p40); cap.measure.mass.v1 with optional channel net/gross/tare and settle (settle=true refuses an unstable reading because the facade has no settle primitive); the e-stop and teardown close the transport (Balance.close). NOT COVERED: the hardware path was never opened; the fake is an in-memory stand-in with placeholder values, not a recording of a device; the clone's sync facade, sinks, streaming, tare/zero commands, calibration, protocol switching, baud rate, SBN address and raw parameter read/write are not exposed; cap.measure.mass.v1 is limited to the three readings this driver exposes. DISPLAY UNITS: the driver exposes only g, kg, mg and µg because the SDK's UCUM converter has no conversion for the upstream's carat, pound, ounce, tael and other display units, so a balance configured to one of those units reports MHS.DEVICE.PRECONDITION_UNMET from the mass reads until the display unit is set back. The fake keeps answering reads after close so the runtime can build the e-stop receipt; a real closed serial port would refuse further I/O. SAFETY: risk is the card floor R1; the e-stop is a software transport close and no independent hardware e-stop is claimed (SAFE-045 applies at R2 and above). The loader refuses the hardware backend of an unreviewed model-written package only at R2 and R3, so this R1 package has no such protection; an operator must not use its hardware backend without a person at the instrument. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; the gate.digest above is the digest line the last check printed.
